1: for iteration \(= 1,2,\ldots\) do   
2: for \(i = 1,2,\dots ,\tilde{N}\) do   
3: for \(n = 1,2,\dots ,N\) do   
4: Obtain observation \(\mathbf{o}_{n,i}\) from environment i.   
5: Calculate continuous and discrete action distributions \(\pi_{\theta_{\mathrm{old}}}^{\mathrm{cont}}(\mathbf{a}_{n,i}^{1:U}|\mathbf{h}_{n,i})\) and \(\pi_{\theta_{\mathrm{old}}}^{\mathrm{disc}}(\mathbf{1}_{n,i}|\mathbf{h}_{n,i})\) using Eqns. (23), (41a), (41b).   
6: Sample a combined action \(\mathbf{a}_{n,i} = (\mathbf{a}_{n,i}^{1:U},\mathbf{1}_{n,i})\) from the above distributions.   
7: Execute \(\mathbf{a}_{n,i}\) to obtain the reward \(r_n,i\)   
8: Derive advantage estimates \(A_{1:N,i}\) using Eqns. (32), (34), (35), (39b), and (41c).   
9: Assemble trajectory \(\chi_{1:N,i}\)   
10: end for   
11: end for   
12: Segment trajectories \(\chi_{1:N,1:\tilde{N}}\) into \(\mathcal{T} = \{\chi_{1:K,1:\tilde{N}},\chi_{2:(K + 1),1:\tilde{N}},\dots ,\chi_{(N - K):N,1:\tilde{N}}\}\)   
13: Optimize \(L_{n}^{\mathrm{hybrid + VF + S}}\) according to Eqns. (40a), (40b), and (40c) with respect to \(\theta\) for \(K\) epochs, using the mini-batch of size \(M\leq N(N - K)\) and a learning rate \(l_{r}\)   
14: Update \(\theta_{\mathrm{old}}\) to \(\theta\) : \(\theta_{\mathrm{old}}\gets \theta\)   
15: end for
